author: Giorgio Mendoza
description: Compulab has detailed its IOT-GATE-IMX8PV2, a fanless industrial IoT gateway powered by NXP’s i.MX8M Plus processor. The small-form-factor system combines dual Gigabit Ethernet, optional Wi-Fi 6 and LTE connectivity, and isolated industrial I/O in a 105 × 80 × 30mm aluminum enclosure. title: Miniature industrial IoT gateway with dual Gigabit Ethernet and optional Wi-Fi 6, LTE
